_comment: Approved toil taxonomy for ToilMap. Only human-approved categories live here, and every change is a reviewed commit, so git history is the audit trail. Model-proposed categories are returned with category_status new and kept in a separate working store until a reviewer approves, renames, or rejects them.

categories.name: hardware_failure
categories.label: Hardware Failure
categories.description: A physical network component fails: chassis, line card, power supply, fan, optic/SFP, transceiver degradation. Remediated by replacing or RMA'ing the part.

categories.name: link_circuit_carrier
categories.label: Link / Circuit / Carrier
categories.description: Physical-layer or carrier-level connectivity issue: fiber cut, flapping interface, last-mile carrier outage. Remediation often involves the carrier, not just internal teams.

categories.name: routing_bgp
categories.label: Routing / BGP
categories.description: Routing-layer issue: flapping BGP sessions, route leaks, misconfigured peers, route table exhaustion, route hijacks.

categories.name: change_induced_errors
categories.label: Change-Induced Errors
categories.description: An incident traced to a change that was made or executed incorrectly --a bad config push, an ACL/VLAN error, a missed runbook step, or a process gap during a change. The outage must begin after a change was applied. It is not a change-induced error when the trigger was something lapsing or running out,because no change was applied when the outage began.

categories.name: capacity_congestion
categories.label: Capacity / Congestion
categories.description: Bandwidth saturation, buffer overflow, QoS starvation, or a link/device undersized for current traffic.

categories.name: dns
categories.label: DNS
categories.description: DNS resolution failures, propagation delay, or misconfigured records.

categories.name: power_environmental
categories.label: Power / Environmental
categories.description: Facility-level event: UPS failure, cooling/HVAC event, data-center power loss. Tracked separately from hardware_failure because the blast radius and owning team (facilities/DC ops) differ.

categories.name: security
categories.label: Security
categories.description: DDoS, unauthorized access attempt, or malware with network-visible symptoms.

categories.name: software_firmware_bug
categories.label: Software / Firmware Bug
categories.description: A known or newly discovered vendor defect, memory leak, or OS-level bug requiring a patch or workaround.

categories.name: third_party_upstream
categories.label: Third-Party / Upstream Dependency
categories.description: An outage or degradation in an upstream provider, peering partner, or external dependency outside the team's direct control.

not_toil.name: not_toil
not_toil.label: Not Toil
not_toil.description: A confident judgement that the incident is either a genuine one-off with no recurring pattern or a planned, expected event, so it belongs in no toil category. Distinct from a null category, which means the model could not decide and a human must review.
